sourceTitle: Foster carer fees and allowances (Scottish Borders Council)

fees.label: Retainer (no child placed, up to eight weeks)

feesNote: The Scottish Borders pays a fee for each child placed, at level one or level two, on top of the child's allowance; the retainer replaces fees and allowances while a carer has no child living with them.
extras: Allowances and fees are paid over 56 weeks a year rather than 52
The extra four weeks cover a birthday payment of one week's allowance, a summer payment of two weeks' allowance and a Christmas payment of one week's allowance
summary: Scottish Borders Council publishes its fees and allowances as of April 2026, with child allowances at the Scottish Recommended Allowance rates and a per-child fee for the carer on top. A level one carer looking after a child aged 5 to 15 would receive £206.71 in allowance and £194.29 in fee each week.
